en.headline: Customs seizes 7kg cannabis at airport, arrests three mainland men
en.dek: Two separate cases today involved passengers arriving from Bangkok with suspected cannabis buds hidden in snack packaging inside carry-on bags.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected two drug trafficking cases at Hong Kong International Airport on 19 September and seized a total of about 7 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of about HK$1.4 million. Three mainland men were arrested.

In the first case, a 40-year-old mainland male passenger arriving from Bangkok was found with about 1 kg of suspected cannabis buds concealed in snack packaging inside his carry-on backpack. In the second case, two mainland men aged 35 and 37, also arriving from Bangkok, were stopped after officers found about 6 kg of suspected cannabis buds hidden in snack packaging inside one man's carry-on baggage.
Investigations continue. Customs said it would step up enforcement through intelligence analysis and reminded the public not to take part in drug trafficking for money.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢約7公斤大麻花拘三名內地男子
zh.dek: 今日兩宗個案，三名由曼谷抵港的內地男子在手提行李零食包裝內藏有懷疑大麻花，合共約7公斤，市值約140萬元。
body: 香港海關今日（19日）在香港國際機場偵破兩宗販毒案，合共檢獲約7公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約140萬元，並拘捕三名內地男子。
第一宗案中，一名40歲內地男旅客由曼谷抵港，海關人員在其手提背包的零食包裝內發現約1公斤懷疑大麻花。第二宗案中，兩名分別35歲及37歲的內地男子同樣由曼谷抵港，其中一人的手提行李零食包裝內藏有約6公斤懷疑大麻花，兩人其後被捕。
案件仍在調查。海關表示會繼續透過情報分析加強打擊販毒活動，並提醒市民切勿因金錢報酬而參與販毒。
